verification_policy: Date conservative: verified_at uses UTC start of the observed day, not an invented exact test time. Maximum 48h without a new cart test. Every published coupon must have a positive item-level cart test; partner-provided and source-only offers are never publishable. Owner-confirmed CIOTOLA30 is published distinctly from cart-tested offers; its confirmation must be dated, with recheck_after exactly 14 days later. After that point the card says 'Da riconfermare' until expires_at, when it must no longer be active. This does not renew or fabricate a cart test.
